title: Chapter 568 - 568 Lin Fan; Arrival!

Chapter 568 - 568 Lin Fan; Arrival!

Chapter 568 - 568 Lin Fan; Arrival!

568 Lin Fan; Arrival!

At the same time, in the emergency training bases of other countries…

When the countdown reached zero, all the chosen people disappeared into thin air.

Perhaps some people were still a little confused about the doomsday declaration and the chosen ones.

At this moment, they gradually began to believe it.

It was also at this moment…

A high-definition image suddenly appeared at the dark Void Gates.

According to the people’s observations, these images… were a panoramic live broadcast of the chosen ones from various countries!

This appearance once again sparked a global debate.

Feng: [Look at the long grass. Why does this feel like the wilderness in the movies?]

Man of Heaven: [All heroes seem to have suddenly disappeared and then appeared in the wilderness.]

Xiaoxiao: [F*ck! I just saw a hero from Eagle Country in the live stream. He actually brought a sniper rifle there.]

Culinary God: [What is this? There was a hero from Nashland who had a long sword, a Gatling gun, a sniper rifle, a pistol, and a grenade tied to his body… He had all kinds of weapons!]

Wind: [F*ck! That’s awesome! Where are our heroes?]

Silly Laughter: [By the way, where’s Hua Nation’s hero? Why aren’t there any images from the Void Gate?]

Fallen Leaf: [Yeah! What about the live stream? Could it be that no one from Hua Nation was selected?]

Aihua: [What should we do then? Are we all going to die?]

Wind: [I don’t want to die yet.]

…

While everyone was discussing and feeling terrified, the live stream of Hua Nation’s Void Gate finally began to shake.

In the next moment…

A patch of barren grassland that was half the height of a person appeared in everyone’s sight.

The scene changed slightly to a tall and handsome man.

Seeing this…

Countless cameras were focused and synchronized to all the major online live broadcast rooms.

Love: [Is this the hero of Hua Nation? He looks quite handsome.]

Flower: [Handsome? That’s right! He’s indeed very handsome. However, other than being handsome, does he have any other merits?

[All of us… even the entire country was looking for him, wanting to give him the best training and the best weapons so that he could perform well in the Otherworld and prevent the arrival of the apocalypse.

[But he never appeared!]

Family: [Ah, look at his clothes. He definitely wasn’t living in a mountain village without internet!]

Seven Lotus Seeds: [Oh no, he seems to be the only hero in our country! Although he’s handsome, this is the Otherworld. He didn’t receive any training and didn’t bring any weapons… It’s over. Our doomsday is coming.]

123 Blockhead: [Why?! Why didn’t he take the initiative to say that he was chosen earlier?]

Red: [This kind of person is the most selfish and cowardly!]

…

This time, the live broadcast was not only watched by ordinary people but also by everyone in the Jingbei conference room.

When the man sitting at the top saw the person in the live stream, his pupils constricted slightly.

The people below were discussing in low voices.

“Fortunately, there’s someone from China who was chosen…”

“Yes, unfortunately, from the current situation, he’s the only chosen one.”

“Why didn’t he tell us?”

“I hope that this won’t require a show of strength in the Otherworld. Sigh.”

…

When everyone said this, their faces could not help but reveal a hint of bitterness.

Did not require a show of strength?

In the unknown wilderness, were there no poisonous insects or ferocious beasts?

What if their hero met people from other countries?

Almost everyone had firearms in their hands!

Wherever there were people, there would be fights.

If the other party had some bad intentions, it would definitely be a very terrifying thing.

“I’ll get someone to investigate the specific information of this hero,” someone said.

At this moment…

The man who had been sitting on the main seat and had not spoken all this time said, “There’s no need to investigate. He’s Professor Lin Fan.”

Silence.

The entire venue fell silent.

The chosen one was Professor Lin Fan!

…

On the other hand, Hua Nation’s top TV station had already prepared a grand live broadcast venue for this incident.

When the scene appeared at the Void Gate, the TV station also began a live broadcast on the internet.

As the host of this live broadcast, Xiao Bing smiled and said, “Three days ago, everyone in the world heard the doomsday declaration at the same time. Because of this incident, many of us experienced panic, fear, and other emotions.

“However, for the time being, we still don’t know if the apocalypse will really happen.

“However, even if the doomsday declaration is completely true, we don’t have to be too afraid.

“Because there are still heroes protecting us!

“Now, the hero of Hua Nation… has appeared!”

Xiao Bing’s voice was full of fighting spirit, as if it had the magical power to pull back the people who had fallen into the darkness.

In the next moment…

Xiao Bing’s mouth was wide open as she cried out in surprise, “How could it be him?!”

Not long ago, Xiao Bing went to Swede as a representative to broadcast the Nobel Prize awards ceremony live.

Even though the cameras did not capture Lin Fan’s face, Xiao Bing had seen Lin Fan with her own eyes!

Now, Lin Fan had actually appeared in the live stream. In other words… Lin Fan was the chosen one!

He was the great existence who won four Nobel Prizes!

Any live stream of videos from the Otherworld would attract the attention of many people.

This TV station was an authoritative media outlet, and it was always the center of attention.

In addition, Xiao Bing was currently the most famous host.

This directly produced a qualitative change and attracted the attention of countless people.

After the audience heard Xiao Bing’s surprise, countless people sent out messages.

Instantly, the entire live broadcast room was filled with dense bullet comments.

Moonrise Willow Head: [Xiao Bing, do you know this chosen person?]

Kyushu: [Who is he?]

Prince: [Xiao Bing, tell me quickly.]

Wan: [Xiao Bing, please speak quickly.]

Person in the Wind: [Who is he?]

Emperor: [Who is he?]

One, Two, Three: [Who is he?]

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to everyone’s shock, discussion, and doubts.

The moment he arrived in the Otherworld, a crisp voice suddenly sounded in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve triggered mission—rest for six hours. After entering the Otherworld for the first time and resting for six hours, you can truly feel the air, temperature, and humidity of the Otherworld. This is how you show respect for the environment. Reward: Skill—Gravity Control!]

Gravity Control?

Even though Lin Fan could not see the exact use of this skill, just looking at this name made his eyes light up.

After resting for six hours, he could obtain a skill. Not bad!

Lin Fan sat down on the ground without any hesitation.

He looked at the blue sky, looked into the distance, and listened to the birds and bugs whispering to each other. He did not feel bored.

He even felt a different kind of relief.
